textos.aviso: Synthetic data trial. States reflect punches recorded at the specified cutoff.
textos.cobertura: Coverage indicates whether the synthetic source contains the complete sequence from the start of the date to the cutoff.
textos.limites: With no punches, incomplete data or ambiguous data, the state remains undetermined. This trial does not calculate hours or attest physical presence or absence.
textos.entrada_invalida: The trial could not be read. Check the files, their hashes and the language.
textos.cobertura_incompleta: The source does not cover the full period up to the cutoff. Check its coverage.
textos.sin_marcajes: The source covers the period but contains no punches. Check the records for that date.
textos.secuencia_ambigua: Punches have identical times or an inconsistent sequence. Check their order and type.
